WHAT: Complete fix for history system that had multiple compounding failures
WHERE: `src-tauri/src/features/history/service.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/history.rs`, `src-tauri/src/core/service_registry/phases/platform_services.rs`
FIXES APPLIED:
1. Startup migration repairs 1,534 meta.json files with `T` instead of `:` in created_at. Uses `.timestamps_repaired` marker file to run only once.
2. `parse_history_item` only requires non-empty transcript — all other fields (created_at, source, folder, id, paths) have fallback chains, no `?` operators except file read and JSON parse.
3. `created_at` fallback chain: JSON parse → folder name (`2025-07-28T18-56-27-...`) → file mtime → Unix epoch
4. `load_unified_history_with_count` returns `(items, total_valid)` single-pass — no separate `get_total_count()` call
5. RwLock dropped before I/O in pagination loop
6. `has_more = items.len() == limit && offset + limit < total_count`
GOTCHA: Timestamp repair regex is `(T\d{2})T(\d{2}:)` NOT `(\d{2})T(\d{2}:)` — the latter also matches valid ISO timestamps
